description: Fetch any Statistics Canada series by its numeric vector id (e.g. 41690973 = CPI all-items) — escape hatch for the full StatCan catalogue. Find vector ids at www150.statcan.gc.ca (table/cube pages list their vectors). Returns recent observations + series title.

vector_id.description: StatCan vector id, numeric (with or without a leading "v"), e.g. "41690973".

name: statcan_series
title: Statcan Series
